libFLAC 1.5.0 is supplied as the unmodified official source archive for reproducible offline Android builds.

Source: https://downloads.xiph.org/releases/flac/flac-1.5.0.tar.xz

SHA-256: `f2c1c76592a82ffff8413ba3c4a1299b6c7ab06c734dee03fd88630485c2b920`

Only the BSD-licensed libFLAC library is linked. Command-line programs, C++ bindings, Ogg support, examples, documentation and upstream tests are disabled. The original archive retains all upstream licenses. The library license is also packaged in `assets/licenses/libFLAC.txt`.
